content:
I've opened a series of PRs formalizing Green's relations and theorems for finite semigroups (towards Simon's Factorization Forest Theorem).

@Yaël Dillies kindly took a first look but suggested I find a maintainer more familiar with this material.

The PRs are structured as follows:

  • #40050: Definitions.
  • #41822: Non-trivial results, including Green's Lemma and proof that D = J for finite semigroups.

Would anyone familiar with this area be available to review?
They're not a maintainer but maybe @Timothy Harevy can help take a look (#new members > Semigroups)
